newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: EC report confirms Portugal convergence -BoP.
newsitem.headline: EC report confirms Portugal convergence -BoP.

text.p: Forecasts by the European Commission showing Portugal passing a key budget test for the single currency were confirmation of the country's economic convergence with its richer partners, deputy Bank of Portugal governor Luis Campos e Cunha said.
"The figures presented by Brussels simply confirm that which has been a goal for years...it is a sustainable goal which has big social and political support," he told Reuters.
Campos e Cunha said that the process of nominal convergence, demonstrated by the Commission numbers, was being translated into a real convergence of living standards.
"The rate of growth of the Portuguese economy was higher than (the average of) Europe in 1996 and will certainly be so again in 1997," he said.
The Commission forecast on Wednesday a budget deficit of three percent of gross domestic product (GDP) for 1997, in line with the limit for entry to monetary union.
